capabilities: show active keyboard layout next to the text caret
convert selected or current word between layouts via a shortcut
correct sequences of preceding words with repeated presses
extras: The README is bilingual (Russian and English); on Linux the indicator only appears when one of the supported layout tools is installed, and the Print Screen default shortcut may conflict with system screenshot bindings.
problem: Obsidian does not show which keyboard layout is active while typing, so text can be typed in the wrong language before it is noticed.

requires.name: niri, Fcitx 5, IBus, Sway, Hyprland, or xkblayout-state

summary: Keyboard layout indicator that shows the active ru/en layout next to the caret and converts mistyped words between layouts.
